bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the English-centric bias in lexical-semantic resources and Large Language Models (LLMs) by measuring their ability to identify cross-lingual lexical gaps. The paper compares zero-shot LLM performance (GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3, Gemini 2.0 Flash) against native-speaker crowdsourced data in mapping domain-specific terms (food terminology) across English, Arabic, Indonesian, and Banjarese.

Assessing the failure of models and linguistic resources to capture culturally grounded semantics and sociocultural awareness. The evaluation is done by analyzing mistranslations, hallucinations, and literal translations of culturally embedded food terms across diverse language pairs with distinct cultural backgrounds.
